The ranger's hands and feet grow webs, and his body grows an oily fur that is water resistant. While in this form, the ranger gains a swim speed of 30 feet and a +8 bonus on Swim checks.|!PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Shapeshifter ~ Master Shifter

The ranger's hands and feet grow webs, and his body grows an oily fur that is water resistant. While in this form, the ranger gains a swim speed of 60 feet and a +5 bonus on Swim checks. Alternatively, the ranger can polymorph into the form of an otter or similar river mammal as if the caster of beast shape IV.|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Shapeshifter ~ Master Shifter
